notablePrerequisites:
Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
description:
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.
